    User guide

    How to use

    Select a layer for definitions and protocols, play a communication sequence, or open a protocol workflow.

    1. Choose a modelSwitch between seven-layer OSI and four-layer TCP/IP on the left.
    2. Select a layer blockBoth hosts highlight the same layer; definitions and protocols appear on the right.
    3. Explore the conceptsExpand definitions, mechanisms, protocol details and common misconceptions.
    4. Play communicationPlay or step through encapsulation, routing and receiver decapsulation.
    5. Open transport labsOpen the lab from the transport layer details to observe TCP connection setup and closing, or UDP loss and reordering.
    6. Learn and calculateScroll to principles, packet fields and five network calculators.
    7. Illustrated protocol guideOpen the protocol guide, choose an entry by layer and select diagram steps to read mechanisms, fields and relationships. Download the source from the header.

    This is a teaching simulation; it creates no real TCP connections or network packets. Press Esc to close.
